name: civit-tool
description: Unified CLI for day-to-day LoRA file management: rename, Civitai URL lookup, activation/wildcard generation, image sorting, duplicate finding, wildcard expansion and wildcard linting.

file.description: Bulk file operations: rename by find/replace or by sequence.

img.description: Generated images: sort into one folder per model, extract their metadata or prompts, rank the LoRAs they used.

lora.description: LoRA files: activation words and wildcard block, Civitai links, duplicates.

wc.description: Wildcard YAML files: expand to prompts, lint, find repeats, sort keys.
